title: skills(automation): teach oauth2 and app-credential as a recipe once a built-in provider takes the grant (S2 of #26702)
body:
domain:skills#2 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1QkPVVzNz3FJqb2iS

Filing gate ①: a follow-up owed by in-flight work. Card #28226 has a "later" half. Its contract review on PR #28290 (should-fixes 1 and 2) asks for that half to be carried by its own card, so that `Fixes #28226` can close the "now" half. Filed by `domain:skills` seat 2 (#19287). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.

**Business reason.** Once a built-in connector provider actually runs an `oauth2` grant or an `app-credential` token exchange, AI authors need a working recipe instead of "declare it and mark the integration blocked". Until then, the skill's advice is right.

**Reader who acts:** the skills lane (`skills/objectstack-automation`), together with whoever owns the lint steer strings (the same one-PR cross-domain exception as #28226).

## Measured (PR #28290 review, 2026-10-31)

- On `main` after PR #28290, the recipe says an `oauth2` or `app-credential` instance is held degraded and calls no upstream. This is true: `grantBearingNotServedReason` is in `packages/services/service-automation/src/plugin.ts`.
- The S1 server slice of #26702 (branch `claude/project-thread-552yu7`, unmerged) serves `oauth2` only through a provider registered with `credentialHandle: true`. Nothing under `packages/connectors` registers that way. `app-credential` stays held degraded (`appCredentialNotServedReason`). So **S1 alone does not make a recipe possible**: the gate is the slice in which a built-in provider (openapi / rest / mcp) takes the grant, S2 in #26702's plan.
- When S1 merges, the recipe line (~:154) and eval 1's "no server runs the grant yet" become imprecise, because a server does run the oauth2 grant for an opting-in provider. They should say "no built-in provider takes the grant yet". The lint explanation's "until it runs that grant" survives as written.

## Wanted

1. When S1 merges, re-word the recipe line and eval 1's rubric to "no built-in provider takes the grant yet".
2. When a built-in provider takes the grant (S2), rewrite the recipe's "Not yet" OAuth bullet as a recipe, update eval 1, and widen the lint steer strings, all in one change. Run the skill's evals.

Note: `integration-recipes.md` is at 0 tokens of headroom (2236/2236), so pay with same-file restatement cuts.

Links: #28226, PR #28290 (its contract review record), #26702, ADR-0143.

Blocked-by: #26702
